data.name: Carmine
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘carmine’, meaning deep red, this name is rich in symbolism and history. In the Christian tradition, Carmine is associated with the blood of Christ, making it a powerful and spiritual name for a boy.

in_hebrew.name: קרמין
in_hebrew.meaning: זהו שם נשארים עם כוח וגבורה, יש קשר לצבע, צבע של דם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קרמין הוא שם שמקורו מלטינית, כבר בעבר הקדום היה שם כבד, נאמן הכוח, כך כתבו הרבים בתקופה הביזנטית, בעת העתיקה ובאלף השנים שעברו, והיום נזכרים בזה, כבלי-עב, כדם וכצבע, כהוקרה לכוח שבתוכנו.

in_greek.name: Καρμίνης
in_greek.meaning: ονομαζεται αυτος με την ελπιδα και την δυναμη
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Κάρμινης είναι ένα όνομα που κατάγεται από την ιταλική λέξη για το χρώμα, ονομάζω την έμμονη ελπίδα και την αληθινή δύναμη, οι αρχαίοι Έλληνες δέχθηκαν αυτή την ιταλική λέξη, και η οποία πήρε την σημασία της δύναμης, του θάρρους και της ελπίδας, και έτσι πέρασε στα χέρια μας αιώνες πέρα.

in_latin.name: Carmine
in_latin.long_meaning: Carmine est nomen quod in antiquitate significabat fortitudo et robur, in usu Christianorum erat nomen quod significabat robur animus, fortitudo et virtus, et hodie in usu est nomen quod significat fortitudo et robur.

data.cultural_impact: Carmine is a name rooted in ancient traditions, holding cultural significance beyond its association with Christianity. The deep red hue of the name traces back to its Latin origin, representing strength, passion, and beauty. In the Italian culture, Carmine is a name given to boys born in the month of July, attributing it to the vibrant red sunsets. It is also a popular name amongst the Sicilian community, where it is believed to bring good luck and health.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, the name Carmine is deeply spiritual as it is a reminder of the price paid for salvation through the shedding of Jesus Christ's blood. The name evokes images of sacrifice and love, and when given as a child's name, it is a powerful reminder of the deep spiritual relationship between God and his children. The name provides a daily reminder of the sacrifice and love that Jesus showed for all humanity, making it a deeply meaningful and significant name for families looking to pass down their faith to future generations.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Carmine was a common name in medieval Italy. The name Carmine carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
